column1: * The following is the list of plates in the on-line Consolidated Lunar Atlas from the Lunar and Planetary Laboratory
* It has been put in a format which (when saved as a  .csv  file) can be read by the PSS feature in LTVT
* Note:  blank rows and rows starting with a * are treated as comments and ignored by LTVT
*  Please do not use any commas or semi-colons anywhere in this file -- they will lead to a bad .csv version and confuse LTVT
